findings.explanation: encryptCredential() dung IV/nonce co dinh (12 byte toan so 0) cho MOI lan goi, thay vi sinh moi bang crypto.randomBytes(12). Voi AES-256-GCM, tai su dung cung (key, IV) lam lo keystream: hai ban ma cung key/IV cho phep XOR de suy ra XOR cua hai plaintext, va con cho phep gia mao (forge) authentication tag qua ky thuat GCM nonce-reuse (khoi phuc auth subkey H). Vi deriveCredentialKey() la ham xac dinh (sha256 cua masterKey) nen tat ca credential ma hoa voi cung masterKey deu dung chung 1 (key, IV) co dinh -> vi pham nghiem trong an toan GCM. Fix: `const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);` va luu iv kem ciphertext (co san co che base64UrlEncode(iv) trong envelope, chi can sinh IV ngau nhien truoc khi tao cipher).
